## Strongest current statements

Covered closed construction and valid constraint-allocation history derive
sufficient fuels and one mathematical width for any prescribed finite number
of modeled node-processing rounds and any budget. With empty inherited
payload, the final available node accepts exactly the original finite-tree
language for every ambient context and term under formal Formula and

`e4665b0bb522ec88f1925fe6bc360b76e9e4bdfbe6192210ac708a3097a20cc5`.

The new resource theorem is
`SourcePruningEnumerationRecursive.run_finite_complete_resources`.
For any Nat recursiveFuel, original Packet, Fits, finite guard carrier,
selector membership/length laws, original suspended-mass ceiling and
FiniteReservation.Reserved derive a stable actual Recursive.run result.
Every larger work fuel returns that same result. OutcomeResources retains

## Original recursive forecast

FiniteReservation.final 0 seed B = seed.
Let start = ExpansionAdmission.narrowSeed seed and
rows(seed) = scalar(start.profile)+1.
For smaller depth d, step d seed B L =
  final d (RecursiveReservation.afterHead seed L)
    (RecursiveReservation.massCeil seed B L).
Stage iterates this same step with fixed captured mass B and inherited length L.
Then final (d+1) seed B = stage d start B B (rows seed).

The forecast recurses only on depth. A generic finite iterate keeps each
sibling schedule in its original order. No future selected rows, cache,
receipt, native result or execution enters the forecast. The explicit
original mass ceiling removes the need to compare whole recursive forecasts
at different masses or arbitrary guard alphabets. Same-schedule growth and
count padding suffice. Repeated guards and selected rows remain counted.

HeadReserved pays the current edge's original mixed-query cost and the
smaller-depth driver's reservation at the planned head endpoint and mass
ceiling. ScanReserved pays that pair at every original stage index.
Reserved at positive depth is exactly the original scan reservation after
narrowing. One extra row stage covers a parked first expansion. Final Room
supplies every nested reservation by depth induction. reserved_computed
uses roomBits of the final profile to choose one mathematical width.
This does not assert room at a fixed physical host width.

## Actual execution and retained certificates

FiniteContract.Complete universally quantifies original inventory, caller,
full memos, cache, metadata, seed and mass ceiling. It requires the same
current packet, bounds and selector laws as the public driver. Each helper
uses it only at the strictly smaller recursive depth. It is a definition
of the induction statement, not an added axiom or future successful outcome.

FiniteCallbackResources uses callback_complete once. It keeps its entire
callback packet, RenderStable, Frame, metadata fields and generic equation
for every continuation. Frame.values preserves the same original mass ceiling
at the actual returned callback cache. The accepted callback invokes the IH
once there. A rejected callback keeps its actual empty prune. Common summed
fuel covers recording and the actual recursive run.

FiniteReceiptResources uses the same actual advance receipt, context,
pending references and fragment history to derive the callback Packet.
FiniteHeadResources retains every earlier head result after explicit depth
and seed substitutions. It derives the original edge widths, head mass,
actual receipt and callback, all larger-fuel equations, full memos and Post,
and the captured sibling Packet at a completed callback's actual endpoint.

FiniteSiblingCertificates retain indexed ReceiptAt, OutputAt and StoppedAt.
FiniteSiblingResources executes each callback before its suffix. The suffix
uses hookCaller, hookMemos and hookPost. Only the captured enumeration cache
and metadata are restored. Every output keeps its own endpoint and cache.
A stopped result keeps its arbitrary nonempty output suffix, nested reason
and optional endpoint. No rejected cache receives an invented Safe fact.

FiniteSiblingFinishResources retains the ENTIRE earlier generic header and
conclusion, then adds OutcomeResources for the exact finish result. Prefix:
4147 bytes, SHA256
`2d60ae18fc41e333388f75878012e7692bd5c2c9e51bb4ffd28a73e4e622dc61`.
FiniteOrdinaryResources retains actual entry, RenderStable, values, counter,
waiting/index equality, entry Packet and all scan certificates.
FiniteOrdinaryForecastResources derives the selected row ceiling from the
current realized/decoded Available parent, HeapFits and selector length law.
Its entire old generic conclusion stays a prefix: 3385 bytes, SHA256
`ee5371b77b5a8b95eb7492f8ac345b22e46e96b6a3e998d28ccbc563d118fba1`.
Each wrapper calls its earlier producer once.

FiniteParkedResources derives the checked Packet and mass from the literal
same prefix observation. The first reserved pair bounds the unchanged
native caller and the remaining smaller-depth driver. It does not assert
that an edge actually ran. FiniteExpansionResources produces all prefix
observations from original Packet and the current selected expansion.
It covers parked, Empty, ordinary and terminal/nonordinary fallback routes.
Prepared actions remain existential inside each larger-fuel observation.
ResumeDepth composes the actual prefix and actual scan at one common bound.

FiniteRunStep adds initial stop, done and stuck decisions. FiniteResources
